news.title: Mindbody - 2026 Funding Rounds & List of Investors

bullets: Establish a compelling vision for an AI-first B2B user experience across Mindbody’s platform.
Develop and own the product strategy and roadmap for agentic experiences and their enabling platform capabilities.
Identify the workflows where agentic systems can create meaningful customer and business value—not merely add novelty or incremental convenience.
Determine the appropriate interaction models for agents, including proactive assistance, workflow orchestration, recommendations, approvals, and autonomous actions.
Translate rapidly evolving AI capabilities into durable product strategy grounded in customer needs, technical feasibility, economics, and risk.
Own the product strategy, roadmap, and execution for Mindbody’s core multi-studio platform capabilities.
Define how locations within enterprise and franchise networks are modeled, connected, and managed across the platform.
Lead the evolution of cross-studio data relationships, synchronization rules, and inheritance models.
Build intuitive site-to-site navigation and corporate-facing experiences that help enterprise operators manage complex location networks.
Establish scalable cross-studio permissions and access-control models, including role inheritance, exceptions, and appropriate data boundaries.
Own the strategy, roadmap, and governance for Mindbody’s external API ecosystem — the APIs that partners, integrators, and enterprise customers build on.
Treat the API as a product. Set the standards for API design, authentication and authorization, versioning, deprecation lifecycle, rate limiting, and the SLAs our partners depend…
Shape the external developer experience, including documentation, support, sandbox environments, webhooks, and onboarding, so partners can integrate quickly and confidently.
Be the voice of the external developer and partner. Turn integration pain points and usage patterns into a clear point of view on the highest-ROI opportunities for the ecosystem.
Collaborate closely with the Partnerships team and external partners to land strategic integrations that solve real customer pain points and drive meaningful business value.
